stages_examined: question_selection.rs history exclusion and band/within-band selection read-only fixture
delivery.result: All 24 independently chosen easy records, six counterfactuals, and exact five batch records survive filtering. Decision cases and old-shortcut counts preserved. All batch items have nonzero support under explicit positive easy weights; histories can exhaust cases. Actual UI choice permutations checked separately.

limitations: Finite samples and probes cannot prove absence of every shortcut.
No publication preparation exists; read-only actual shared preparation used captured inventory basis 5397. Later inventory can change deduplication.
Live learner histories, policy weights and future entity IDs unavailable; selection fixtures explicitly condition on easy selection. Legacy no-weight policy selects lowest eligible ID.
Exact batch includes two cube roles and both transient signs; it does not cover every role, which is not a per-five-item quota. Probed surface strategies do not answer every member.
One source numerical question has missing captured key/solution/difficulty; unique numerical answer independently derived and omissions retained. Hard calibration is not established.
Inventory audit establishes no affected stored record for the demonstrated prior expression-bank defect; numeric entries not audited for unrelated weaknesses.
